name: Swiss SIRI-SX Live Alerts
description: Realtime SIRI-SX service alerts for Switzerland surfaced from opentransportdata.swiss

opentransportdata-ch-siri-sx.purpose: Realtime SIRI-SX situation and disruption messages for Swiss public transport, surfaced as service alerts by stop, route, and map area
opentransportdata-ch-siri-sx.dataSent: No user data is sent. The complete and unplanned SIRI-SX feeds are polled server-side with an API key and a static requestor reference ("OpenMapX"); the requested stop, route, or bounding box is applied as a local filter on the cached feed and is never forwarded to the provider.
opentransportdata-ch-siri-sx.dataReceived: Nationwide SIRI-SX situation messages: alert text, severity, effect, validity periods, and the affected stops and lines
